digest.component_or_area: git-fetch test fixtures and stall detection
propositions: Full-suite scheduler load causes git-fetch dribble tests to intermittently fail as false stalls when rate-limited fake remote traffic is delayed by scheduling jitter.
The test fixture and production code share a 2-second stall-detection window, but delayed 0.1-second fixture wake-ups reduce actual throughput below the promised rate, triggering false aborts.
Cumulative bytes-owed catch-up calculation cannot recover after libcurl has already aborted during an uninterrupted scheduling gap.
Production 10-second stall window must remain unchanged and be applied to at least one real Git/libcurl integration test to validate above-floor transfer behavior.
Test suite must split deterministic zero-byte stall controls (2-second window) from production-window dribble integration tests to eliminate scheduler-dependent flakes.
